verses.english: YHWH Himself goes ahead of you. He will be with you; He will not let you fail or abandon you. Do not fear or be dismayed.
verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה הוּא הַהֹלֵךְ לְפָנֶיךָ הוּא יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ לֹא תִירָא וְלֹא תֵחָת׃

verses.english: Moses wrote this law and gave it to the priests, Levi’s sons, who carry YHWH’s covenant ark, and to all Israel’s elders.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת וַיִּתְּנָהּ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי לֵוִי הַנֹּשְׂאִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה וְאֶל־כָּל־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Moses commanded them: At the end of seven years, at the appointed time in the year of release, at the Feast of Booths,
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר מִקֵּץ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בְּמֹעֵד שְׁנַת הַשְּׁמִטָּה בְּחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת׃

verses.english: when all Israel comes to appear before YHWH your God at the place He chooses, read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵרָאוֹת אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר תִּקְרָא אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת נֶגֶד כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאָזְנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Assemble the people—men, women, little ones, and the resident foreigner within your towns—so that they hear, learn, fear YHWH your God, and carefully perform all the words of this law.
verses.hebrew: הַקְהֵל אֶת־הָעָם הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטַּף וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ וּלְמַעַן יִלְמְדוּ וְיָרְאוּ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְשָׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

verses.english: Their children who do not know shall hear and learn to fear YHWH your God all the days you live on the ground you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ יִשְׁמְעוּ וְלָמְדוּ לְיִרְאָה אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כָּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם חַיִּים עַל־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: Your time to die has drawn near. Summon Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, so that I may commission him. Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה הֵן קָרְבוּ יָמֶיךָ לָמוּת קְרָא אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְהִתְיַצְּבוּ בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַאֲצַוֶּנּוּ וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: YHWH appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood at the tent’s entrance.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא יְהוָה בָּאֹהֶל בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן וַיַּעֲמֹד עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן עַל־פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: You are about to lie down with your fathers. This people will rise and prostitute itself after the foreign gods of the land it is entering. It will abandon Me and break the covenant I made with it.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה הִנְּךָ שֹׁכֵב עִם־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וְקָם הָעָם הַזֶּה וְזָנָה אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵי נֵכַר־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הוּא בָא־שָׁמָּה בְּקִרְבּוֹ וַעֲזָבַנִי וְהֵפֵר אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר כָּרַתִּי אִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: My anger will burn against it that day. I will abandon them and hide My face from them. It will be devoured, and many calamities and troubles will find it. That day it will say: Have these calamities not found me because my God is not within me?
verses.hebrew: וְחָרָה אַפִּי בוֹ בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא וַעֲזַבְתִּים וְהִסְתַּרְתִּי פָנַי מֵהֶם וְהָיָה לֶאֱכֹל וּמְצָאֻהוּ רָעוֹת רַבּוֹת וְצָרוֹת וְאָמַר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא הֲלֹא עַל כִּי־אֵין אֱלֹהַי בְּקִרְבִּי מְצָאוּנִי הָרָעוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: I will surely hide My face that day because of all the evil it has done by turning to other gods.
verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי הַסְתֵּר אַסְתִּיר פָּנַי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עַל כָּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כִּי פָנָה אֶל־אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

verses.english: Now write this song for yourselves and teach it to Israel’s sons. Put it in their mouths, so that this song may be My witness against Israel’s sons.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כִּתְבוּ לָכֶם אֶת־הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת וְלַמְּדָהּ אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׂימָהּ בְּפִיהֶם לְמַעַן תִּהְיֶה־לִּי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לְעֵד בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: I will bring it into the ground I swore to its fathers, flowing with milk and honey. It will eat, be satisfied, and grow fat, then turn to other gods and serve them. They will despise Me and break My covenant.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֲבִיאֶנּוּ אֶל־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָיו זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ וְאָכַל וְשָׂבַע וְדָשֵׁן וּפָנָה אֶל־אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַעֲבָדוּם וְנִאֲצוּנִי וְהֵפֵר אֶת־בְּרִיתִי׃

verses.english: When many calamities and troubles find it, this song will answer as a witness before it, for it will not be forgotten from its offspring’s mouth. I know its inclination already at work today, before I bring it into the land I swore to give.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי־תִמְצֶאןָ אֹתוֹ רָעוֹת רַבּוֹת וְצָרוֹת וְעָנְתָה הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לְפָנָיו לְעֵד כִּי לֹא תִשָּׁכַח מִפִּי זַרְעוֹ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת־יִצְרוֹ אֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה הַיּוֹם בְּטֶרֶם אֲבִיאֶנּוּ אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבָּעְתִּי׃

verses.english: Moses wrote this song that day and taught it to Israel’s sons.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת־הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיְלַמְּדָהּ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: He commissioned Joshua son of Nun: Be strong and courageous, for you will bring Israel’s sons into the land I swore to them, and I will be with you.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וַיֹּאמֶר חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תָּבִיא אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לָהֶם וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: When Moses finished writing the words of this law in a book, to their very end,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת מֹשֶׁה לִכְתֹּב אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה־הַזֹּאת עַל־סֵפֶר עַד תֻּמָּם׃

verses.english: Moses commanded the Levites who carry YHWH’s covenant ark:
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Take this book of the law and place it beside YHWH your God’s covenant ark, so that it may remain there as a witness against you.
verses.hebrew: לָקֹחַ אֵת סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֹתוֹ מִצַּד אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְהָיָה־שָׁם בְּךָ לְעֵד׃

verses.english: I know your rebellion and stiff neck. While I am still alive with you today, you have rebelled against YHWH; how much more after my death!
verses.hebrew: כִּי אָנֹכִי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת־מֶרְיְךָ וְאֶת־עָרְפְּךָ הַקָּשֶׁה הֵן בְּעוֹדֶנִּי חַי עִמָּכֶם הַיּוֹם מַמְרִים הֱיִתֶם עִם־יְהֹוָה וְאַף כִּי־אַחֲרֵי מוֹתִי׃

verses.english: Assemble all your tribes’ elders and your officers before me, so that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth as witnesses against them.
verses.hebrew: הַקְהִילוּ אֵלַי אֶת־כָּל־זִקְנֵי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם וְשֹׁטְרֵיכֶם וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְאָזְנֵיהֶם אֵת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאָעִידָה בָּם אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: I know that after my death you will become thoroughly corrupt and turn from the way I commanded you. Calamity will meet you in days to come, because you will do evil in YHWH’s eyes, provoking Him through your handiwork.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אַחֲרֵי מוֹתִי כִּי־הַשְׁחֵת תַּשְׁחִתוּן וְסַרְתֶּם מִן־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם וְקָרָאת אֶתְכֶם הָרָעָה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים כִּי־תַעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Moses spoke the words of this song to their end in the hearing of Israel’s entire assembly.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה בְּאָזְנֵי כָּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת עַד תֻּמָּם׃

verses.english: Give ear, heavens, and I will speak; let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
verses.hebrew: הַאֲזִינוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וַאֲדַבֵּרָה וְתִשְׁמַע הָאָרֶץ אִמְרֵי־פִי׃

verses.english: May my teaching fall like rain, my speech flow like dew, like showers on tender grass and abundant rain on vegetation.
verses.hebrew: יַעֲרֹף כַּמָּטָר לִקְחִי תִּזַּל כַּטַּל אִמְרָתִי כִּשְׂעִירִם עֲלֵי־דֶשֶׁא וְכִרְבִיבִים עֲלֵי־עֵשֶׂב׃

verses.english: For I proclaim YHWH’s name; ascribe greatness to our God.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא הָבוּ גֹדֶל לֵאלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: The Rock—His work is perfect, for all His ways are justice. A faithful God without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
verses.hebrew: הַצּוּר תָּמִים פָּעֳלוֹ כִּי כָל־דְּרָכָיו מִשְׁפָּט אֵל אֱמוּנָה וְאֵין עָוֶל צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר הוּא׃

verses.english: They have acted corruptly toward Him; they are not His children because of their blemish—a crooked and twisted generation.
verses.hebrew: שִׁחֵת לוֹ לֹא בָּנָיו מוּמָם דּוֹר עִקֵּשׁ וּפְתַלְתֹּל׃

verses.english: Is this how you repay YHWH, foolish and unwise people? Is He not your father who acquired you, who made and established you?
verses.hebrew: הֲ־לַיְהוָה תִּגְמְלוּ־זֹאת עַם נָבָל וְלֹא חָכָם הֲלוֹא־הוּא אָבִיךָ קָּנֶךָ הוּא עָשְׂךָ וַיְכֹנְנֶךָ׃

verses.english: Remember days of old; consider the years of generation after generation. Ask your father, and he will tell you; your elders, and they will explain.
verses.hebrew: זְכֹר יְמוֹת עוֹלָם בִּינוּ שְׁנוֹת דּוֹר־וָדוֹר שְׁאַל אָבִיךָ וְיַגֵּדְךָ זְקֵנֶיךָ וְיֹאמְרוּ לָךְ׃

verses.english: When the Most High allotted the nations their inheritance, when He separated humanity’s sons, He established the peoples’ boundaries according to the number of Israel’s sons.
verses.hebrew: בְּהַנְחֵל עֶלְיוֹן גּוֹיִם בְּהַפְרִידוֹ בְּנֵי אָדָם יַצֵּב גְּבֻלֹת עַמִּים לְמִסְפַּר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: For YHWH’s portion is His people; Jacob is His measured inheritance.
verses.hebrew: כִּי חֵלֶק יְהֹוָה עַמּוֹ יַעֲקֹב חֶבֶל נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

verses.english: He found him in a wilderness land, in a desolate, howling waste. He encircled him, instructed him, and guarded him like the pupil of His eye.
verses.hebrew: יִמְצָאֵהוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִדְבָּר וּבְתֹהוּ יְלֵל יְשִׁמֹן יְסֹבְבֶנְהוּ יְבוֹנְנֵהוּ יִצְּרֶנְהוּ כְּאִישׁוֹן עֵינוֹ׃

verses.english: Like an eagle stirring its nest, hovering over its young, He spread His wings, took him, and carried him on His pinions.
verses.hebrew: כְּנֶשֶׁר יָעִיר קִנּוֹ עַל־גּוֹזָלָיו יְרַחֵף יִפְרֹשׂ כְּנָפָיו יִקָּחֵהוּ יִשָּׂאֵהוּ עַל־אֶבְרָתוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH alone led him; no foreign god was with him.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בָּדָד יַנְחֶנּוּ וְאֵין עִמּוֹ אֵל נֵכָר׃

verses.english: He made him ride on the heights of the earth, and he ate the field’s produce. He made him suck honey from rock and oil from flinty stone,
verses.hebrew: יַרְכִּבֵהוּ עַל־במותי [בָּמֳתֵי] אָרֶץ וַיֹּאכַל תְּנוּבֹת שָׂדָי וַיֵּנִקֵהוּ דְבַשׁ מִסֶּלַע וְשֶׁמֶן מֵחַלְמִישׁ צוּר׃

verses.english: curds from cattle and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams from Bashan, and goats, with the fat of wheat’s kernels; you drank wine, the grape’s blood.
verses.hebrew: חֶמְאַת בָּקָר וַחֲלֵב צֹאן עִם־חֵלֶב כָּרִים וְאֵילִים בְּנֵי־בָשָׁן וְעַתּוּדִים עִם־חֵלֶב כִּלְיוֹת חִטָּה וְדַם־עֵנָב תִּשְׁתֶּה־חָמֶר׃

verses.english: Jeshurun grew fat and kicked —you grew fat, thick, and sleek. He abandoned God who made him and scorned the Rock of his salvation.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַן יְשֻׁרוּן וַיִּבְעָט שָׁמַנְתָּ עָבִיתָ כָּשִׂיתָ וַיִּטֹּשׁ אֱלוֹהַ עָשָׂהוּ וַיְנַבֵּל צוּר יְשֻׁעָתוֹ׃

verses.english: They made Him jealous with foreign gods; with abominations they provoked Him.
verses.hebrew: יַקְנִאֻהוּ בְּזָרִים בְּתוֹעֵבֹת יַכְעִיסֻהוּ׃

verses.english: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods they had not known, new ones recently arrived, whom your fathers did not fear.
verses.hebrew: יִזְבְּחוּ לַשֵּׁדִים לֹא אֱלֹהַ אֱלֹהִים לֹא יְדָעוּם חֲדָשִׁים מִקָּרֹב בָּאוּ לֹא שְׂעָרוּם אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You neglected the Rock who begat you and forgot the God who gave you birth.
verses.hebrew: צוּר יְלָדְךָ תֶּשִׁי וַתִּשְׁכַּח אֵל מְחֹלְלֶךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH saw and rejected them, provoked by His sons and daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יְהוָה וַיִּנְאָץ מִכַּעַס בָּנָיו וּבְנֹתָיו׃

verses.english: He said: I will hide My face from them and see what their end will be, for they are a perverse generation, children with no faithfulness.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַסְתִּירָה פָנַי מֵהֶם אֶרְאֶה מָה אַחֲרִיתָם כִּי דוֹר תַּהְפֻּכֹת הֵמָּה בָּנִים לֹא־אֵמֻן בָּם׃

verses.english: They made Me jealous with what is no god and provoked Me with their vanities. I will make them jealous with what is no people and provoke them with a foolish nation.
verses.hebrew: הֵם קִנְאוּנִי בְלֹא־אֵל כִּעֲסוּנִי בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם וַאֲנִי אַקְנִיאֵם בְּלֹא־עָם בְּגוֹי נָבָל אַכְעִיסֵם׃

verses.english: A fire kindled in My anger burns to the depths of Sheol, consumes the earth and its produce, and sets the mountains’ foundations ablaze.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֵשׁ קָדְחָה בְאַפִּי וַתִּיקַד עַד־שְׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּית וַתֹּאכַל אֶרֶץ וִיבֻלָהּ וַתְּלַהֵט מוֹסְדֵי הָרִים׃

verses.english: I will heap calamities upon them and spend My arrows against them.
verses.hebrew: אַסְפֶּה עָלֵימוֹ רָעוֹת חִצַּי אֲכַלֶּה־בָּם׃

verses.english: Wasted by hunger, consumed by fever and bitter pestilence, they will face the teeth of animals I send against them, with the venom of creatures crawling in dust.
verses.hebrew: מְזֵי רָעָב וּלְחֻמֵי רֶשֶׁף וְקֶטֶב מְרִירִי וְשֶׁן־בְּהֵמוֹת אֲשַׁלַּח־בָּם עִם־חֲמַת זֹחֲלֵי עָפָר׃

verses.english: Outside the sword will bereave, and inside the chambers terror—young man and virgin, nursing child and gray-haired man alike.
verses.hebrew: מִחוּץ תְּשַׁכֶּל־חֶרֶב וּמֵחֲדָרִים אֵימָה גַּם־בָּחוּר גַּם־בְּתוּלָה יוֹנֵק עִם־אִישׁ שֵׂיבָה׃

verses.english: I said: I would scatter them, erase their memory from humanity,
verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי אַפְאֵיהֶם אַשְׁבִּיתָה מֵאֱנוֹשׁ זִכְרָם׃

verses.english: were it not that I dreaded the enemy’s provocation, lest their adversaries misunderstand and say, Our hand is exalted; YHWH did not do all this.
verses.hebrew: לוּלֵי כַּעַס אוֹיֵב אָגוּר פֶּן־יְנַכְּרוּ צָרֵימוֹ פֶּן־יֹאמְרוּ יָדֵינוּ רָמָה וְלֹא יְהוָה פָּעַל כָּל־זֹאת׃

verses.english: For they are a nation bereft of counsel, with no understanding in them.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־גוֹי אֹבַד עֵצוֹת הֵמָּה וְאֵין בָּהֶם תְּבוּנָה׃

verses.english: If only they were wise, they would understand this and discern their end!
verses.hebrew: לוּ חָכְמוּ יַשְׂכִּילוּ זֹאת יָבִינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָם׃

verses.english: How could one pursue a thousand and two rout ten thousand unless their Rock sold them and YHWH handed them over?
verses.hebrew: אֵיכָה יִרְדֹּף אֶחָד אֶלֶף וּשְׁנַיִם יָנִיסוּ רְבָבָה אִם־לֹא כִּי־צוּרָם מְכָרָם וַיהוָה הִסְגִּירָם׃

verses.english: Their rock is not like our Rock; even our enemies are judges of that.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא כְצוּרֵנוּ צוּרָם וְאֹיְבֵינוּ פְּלִילִים׃

verses.english: Their vine comes from Sodom’s vine and Gomorrah’s fields. Their grapes are poison grapes, their clusters bitter.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־מִגֶּפֶן סְדֹם גַּפְנָם וּמִשַּׁדְמֹת עֲמֹרָה עֲנָבֵמוֹ עִנְּבֵי־רוֹשׁ אַשְׁכְּלֹת מְרֹרֹת לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: Their wine is serpents’ venom, the cruel poison of asps.
verses.hebrew: חֲמַת תַּנִּינִם יֵינָם וְרֹאשׁ פְּתָנִים אַכְזָר׃

verses.english: Is this not stored with Me, sealed in My treasuries?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־הוּא כָּמֻס עִמָּדִי חָתֻם בְּאוֹצְרֹתָי׃

verses.english: Vengeance and repayment are Mine, when their foot slips. Their day of calamity is near, and what awaits them hastens.
verses.hebrew: לִי נָקָם וְשִׁלֵּם לְעֵת תָּמוּט רַגְלָם כִּי קָרוֹב יוֹם אֵידָם וְחָשׁ עֲתִדֹת לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH will vindicate His people and relent concerning His servants when He sees their strength is gone and none remain, confined or free.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָדִין יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְעַל־עֲבָדָיו יִתְנֶחָם כִּי יִרְאֶה כִּי־אָזְלַת יָד וְאֶפֶס עָצוּר וְעָזוּב׃

verses.english: He will say: Where are their gods, the rock in which they sought refuge,
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַר אֵי אֱלֹהֵימוֹ צוּר חָסָיוּ בוֹ׃

verses.english: who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise and help you; let them shelter you.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר חֵלֶב זְבָחֵימוֹ יֹאכֵלוּ יִשְׁתּוּ יֵין נְסִיכָם יָקוּמוּ וְיַעְזְרֻכֶם יְהִי עֲלֵיכֶם סִתְרָה׃

verses.english: See now that I, I am He; there is no god with Me. I put to death and make alive; I have wounded, and I will heal. No one rescues from My hand.
verses.hebrew: רְאוּ עַתָּה כִּי אֲנִי אֲנִי הוּא וְאֵין אֱלֹהִים עִמָּדִי אֲנִי אָמִית וַאֲחַיֶּה מָחַצְתִּי וַאֲנִי אֶרְפָּא וְאֵין מִיָּדִי מַצִּיל׃

verses.english: I lift My hand to heaven and declare: I live forever.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֶשָּׂא אֶל־שָׁמַיִם יָדִי וְאָמַרְתִּי חַי אָנֹכִי לְעֹלָם׃

verses.english: When I sharpen My flashing sword and My hand takes hold of judgment, I will return vengeance upon My adversaries and repay those who hate Me.
verses.hebrew: אִם־שַׁנּוֹתִי בְּרַק חַרְבִּי וְתֹאחֵז בְּמִשְׁפָּט יָדִי אָשִׁיב נָקָם לְצָרָי וְלִמְשַׂנְאַי אֲשַׁלֵּם׃

verses.english: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, and My sword will consume flesh—the blood of the slain and captives, from the long-haired heads of the enemy.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁכִּיר חִצַּי מִדָּם וְחַרְבִּי תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר מִדַּם חָלָל וְשִׁבְיָה מֵרֹאשׁ פַּרְעוֹת אוֹיֵב׃

verses.english: Sing in praise of His people, you nations, for He avenges the blood of His servants, repays His adversaries, and makes atonement for His land and people.
verses.hebrew: הַרְנִינוּ גוֹיִם עַמּוֹ כִּי דַם־עֲבָדָיו יִקּוֹם וְנָקָם יָשִׁיב לְצָרָיו וְכִפֶּר אַדְמָתוֹ עַמּוֹ׃

verses.english: Moses came and spoke all this song’s words in the people’s hearing, he and Hoshea son of Nun.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה־הַזֹּאת בְּאָזְנֵי הָעָם הוּא וְהוֹשֵׁעַ בִּן־נוּן׃

verses.english: Moses finished speaking all these words to all Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה לְדַבֵּר אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: He said: Set your hearts on all the words I testify to you today. Command your children to keep and perform all the words of this law.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם שִׂימוּ לְבַבְכֶם לְכָל־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מֵעִיד בָּכֶם הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר תְּצַוֻּם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

verses.english: This is no empty matter for you; it is your life. Through this word you will live long on the ground you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־דָבָר רֵק הוּא מִכֶּם כִּי־הוּא חַיֵּיכֶם וּבַדָּבָר הַזֶּה תַּאֲרִיכוּ יָמִים עַל־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

verses.english: That very day YHWH spoke to Moses:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Ascend this mountain of Abarim, Mount Nebo in Moab opposite Jericho, and see the land of Canaan that I am giving Israel’s sons as a possession.
verses.hebrew: עֲלֵה אֶל־הַר הָעֲבָרִים הַזֶּה הַר־נְבוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יְרֵחוֹ וּרְאֵה אֶת־אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

verses.english: Die on the mountain you ascend and be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,
verses.hebrew: וּמֻת בָּהָר אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹלֶה שָׁמָּה וְהֵאָסֵף אֶל־עַמֶּיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר־מֵת אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ בְּהֹר הָהָר וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל־עַמָּיו׃

verses.english: because you acted unfaithfully toward Me among Israel’s sons at the waters of Meribah-kadesh in the wilderness of Zin, failing to uphold My holiness among Israel’s sons.
verses.hebrew: עַל אֲשֶׁר מְעַלְתֶּם בִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמֵי־מְרִיבַת קָדֵשׁ מִדְבַּר־צִן עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־קִדַּשְׁתֶּם אוֹתִי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: You will see the land from a distance, but you will not enter the land I am giving Israel’s sons.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִנֶּגֶד תִּרְאֶה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְשָׁמָּה לֹא תָבוֹא אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי נֹתֵן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: This is the blessing with which Moses, the man of God, blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת הַבְּרָכָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרַךְ מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: He said: “YHWH came from Sinai and dawned from Seir upon them. He shone from Mount Paran and came from holy myriads; at His right hand was a fiery law for them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה מִסִּינַי בָּא וְזָרַח מִשֵּׂעִיר לָמוֹ הוֹפִיעַ מֵהַר פָּארָן וְאָתָה מֵרִבְבֹת קֹדֶשׁ מִימִינוֹ אשדת [אֵשׁ] [דָּת] לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: Indeed, He cherishes peoples; all His holy ones are in Your hand. They gathered at Your feet; each receives Your words.
verses.hebrew: אַף חֹבֵב עַמִּים כָּל־קְדֹשָׁיו בְּיָדֶךָ וְהֵם תֻּכּוּ לְרַגְלֶךָ יִשָּׂא מִדַּבְּרֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹרָה צִוָּה־לָנוּ מֹשֶׁה מוֹרָשָׁה קְהִלַּת יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: There was a king in Jeshurun when the heads of the people gathered, together with the tribes of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: May Reuben live and not die, and may his men be numbered.”
verses.hebrew: יְחִי רְאוּבֵן וְאַל־יָמֹת וִיהִי מְתָיו מִסְפָּר׃

verses.english: Of Judah he said this: “Hear, YHWH, Judah’s voice, and bring him to his people. May his hands contend for him, and may You be a help against his adversaries.”
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת לִיהוּדָה וַיֹּאמַר שְׁמַע יְהוָה קוֹל יְהוּדָה וְאֶל־עַמּוֹ תְּבִיאֶנּוּ יָדָיו רָב לוֹ וְעֵזֶר מִצָּרָיו תִּהְיֶה׃

verses.english: Of Levi he said: “Your Thummim and Your Urim belong to Your loyal man, whom You tested at Massah, with whom You contended at the waters of Meribah.
verses.hebrew: וּלְלֵוִי אָמַר תֻּמֶּיךָ וְאוּרֶיךָ לְאִישׁ חֲסִידֶךָ אֲשֶׁר נִסִּיתוֹ בְּמַסָּה תְּרִיבֵהוּ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה׃

verses.english: He said of his father and mother, ‘I have not seen him’; he did not acknowledge his brothers or know his children, for they kept Your word and guarded Your covenant.
verses.hebrew: הָאֹמֵר לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לֹא רְאִיתִיו וְאֶת־אֶחָיו לֹא הִכִּיר וְאֶת־בנו [בָּנָיו] לֹא יָדָע כִּי שָׁמְרוּ אִמְרָתֶךָ וּבְרִיתְךָ יִנְצֹרוּ׃

verses.english: They shall teach Your judgments to Jacob and Your law to Israel. They shall put incense before Your nostrils and a whole offering on Your altar.
verses.hebrew: יוֹרוּ מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְיַעֲקֹב וְתוֹרָתְךָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל יָשִׂימוּ קְטוֹרָה בְּאַפֶּךָ וְכָלִיל עַל־מִזְבְּחֶךָ׃

verses.english: Bless his strength, YHWH, and accept the work of his hands. Crush the loins of those who rise against him, and of those who hate him, so that they do not rise.”
verses.hebrew: בָּרֵךְ יְהוָה חֵילוֹ וּפֹעַל יָדָיו תִּרְצֶה מְחַץ מָתְנַיִם קָמָיו וּמְשַׂנְאָיו מִן־יְקוּמוּן׃

verses.english: Of Benjamin he said: “YHWH’s beloved shall dwell securely beside Him; He covers him all day, and between his shoulders He dwells.”
verses.hebrew: לְבִנְיָמִן אָמַר יְדִיד יְהֹוָה יִשְׁכֹּן לָבֶטַח עָלָיו חֹפֵף עָלָיו כָּל־הַיּוֹם וּבֵין כְּתֵיפָיו שָׁכֵן׃

verses.english: Of Joseph he said: “Blessed by YHWH be his land, with the precious gifts of heaven, with dew, and with the deep lying below;
verses.hebrew: וּלְיוֹסֵף אָמַר מְבֹרֶכֶת יְהֹוָה אַרְצוֹ מִמֶּגֶד שָׁמַיִם מִטָּל וּמִתְּהוֹם רֹבֶצֶת תָּחַת׃

verses.english: with the precious produce of the sun and the precious yield of the moons;
verses.hebrew: וּמִמֶּגֶד תְּבוּאֹת שָׁמֶשׁ וּמִמֶּגֶד גֶּרֶשׁ יְרָחִים׃

verses.english: with the best of the ancient mountains and the precious gifts of the everlasting hills;
verses.hebrew: וּמֵרֹאשׁ הַרְרֵי־קֶדֶם וּמִמֶּגֶד גִּבְעוֹת עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: with the precious gifts of the earth and its fullness, and the favor of the One who dwells in the bush. May these come upon Joseph’s head, upon the crown of the one set apart among his brothers.
verses.hebrew: וּמִמֶּגֶד אֶרֶץ וּמְלֹאָהּ וּרְצוֹן שֹׁכְנִי סְנֶה תָּבוֹאתָה לְרֹאשׁ יוֹסֵף וּלְקָדְקֹד נְזִיר אֶחָיו׃

verses.english: His majesty is that of a firstborn bull; his horns are the horns of a wild ox. With them he shall gore peoples together to the ends of the earth. These are the myriads of Ephraim, and these the thousands of Manasseh.”
verses.hebrew: בְּכוֹר שׁוֹרוֹ הָדָר לוֹ וְקַרְנֵי רְאֵם קַרְנָיו בָּהֶם עַמִּים יְנַגַּח יַחְדָּו אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ וְהֵם רִבְבוֹת אֶפְרַיִם וְהֵם אַלְפֵי מְנַשֶּׁה׃

verses.english: Of Zebulun he said: “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and Issachar, in your tents.
verses.hebrew: וְלִזְבוּלֻן אָמַר שְׂמַח זְבוּלֻן בְּצֵאתֶךָ וְיִשָּׂשכָר בְּאֹהָלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: They shall summon peoples to the mountain; there they shall sacrifice righteous sacrifices. For they shall draw nourishment from the abundance of seas and the hidden treasures of the sand.”
verses.hebrew: עַמִּים הַר־יִקְרָאוּ שָׁם יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי־צֶדֶק כִּי שֶׁפַע יַמִּים יִינָקוּ וּשְׂפוּנֵי טְמוּנֵי חוֹל׃

verses.english: Of Gad he said: “Blessed is the One who enlarges Gad. He dwells like a lion and tears arm and crown of head.
verses.hebrew: וּלְגָד אָמַר בָּרוּךְ מַרְחִיב גָּד כְּלָבִיא שָׁכֵן וְטָרַף זְרוֹעַ אַף־קָדְקֹד׃

verses.english: He chose the first portion for himself, for there a ruler’s portion was reserved. He came with the heads of the people; he carried out YHWH’s righteousness and His judgments with Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא רֵאשִׁית לוֹ כִּי־שָׁם חֶלְקַת מְחֹקֵק סָפוּן וַיֵּתֵא רָאשֵׁי עָם צִדְקַת יְהוָה עָשָׂה וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Of Dan he said: “Dan is a lion’s cub; he leaps from Bashan.”
verses.hebrew: וּלְדָן אָמַר דָּן גּוּר אַרְיֵה יְזַנֵּק מִן־הַבָּשָׁן׃

verses.english: Of Naphtali he said: “Naphtali, satisfied with favor and full of YHWH’s blessing, possess the sea and the south.”
verses.hebrew: וּלְנַפְתָּלִי אָמַר נַפְתָּלִי שְׂבַע רָצוֹן וּמָלֵא בִּרְכַּת יְהוָה יָם וְדָרוֹם יְרָשָׁה׃

verses.english: Of Asher he said: “Blessed among sons be Asher; may he be favored by his brothers and dip his foot in oil.
verses.hebrew: וּלְאָשֵׁר אָמַר בָּרוּךְ מִבָּנִים אָשֵׁר יְהִי רְצוּי אֶחָיו וְטֹבֵל בַּשֶּׁמֶן רַגְלוֹ׃

verses.english: Your bars shall be iron and bronze, and as your days, so shall your strength be.
verses.hebrew: בַּרְזֶל וּנְחֹשֶׁת מִנְעָלֶיךָ וּכְיָמֶיךָ דָּבְאֶךָ׃

verses.english: There is none like God, O Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to help you, and the clouds in His majesty.
verses.hebrew: אֵין כָּאֵל יְשֻׁרוּן רֹכֵב שָׁמַיִם בְעֶזְרֶךָ וּבְגַאֲוָתוֹ שְׁחָקִים׃

verses.english: The God of old is a refuge, and underneath are everlasting arms. He drove the enemy from before you and said, ‘Destroy!’
verses.hebrew: מְעֹנָה אֱלֹהֵי קֶדֶם וּמִתַּחַת זְרֹעֹת עוֹלָם וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפָּנֶיךָ אוֹיֵב וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁמֵד׃

verses.english: Israel dwelt securely, alone; Jacob’s fountain was in a land of grain and new wine. Indeed, his heavens drip dew.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכֹּן יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּטַח בָּדָד עֵין יַעֲקֹב אֶל־אֶרֶץ דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ אַף־שָׁמָיו יַעַרְפוּ טָל׃

verses.english: Happy are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by YHWH, the shield of your help and the sword of your majesty? Your enemies shall cringe before you, and you shall tread their high places.”
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי כָמוֹךָ עַם נוֹשַׁע בַּיהוָה מָגֵן עֶזְרֶךָ וַאֲשֶׁר־חֶרֶב גַּאֲוָתֶךָ וְיִכָּחֲשׁוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ לָךְ וְאַתָּה עַל־בָּמוֹתֵימוֹ תִדְרֹךְ׃

verses.english: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, the summit of Pisgah opposite Jericho. YHWH showed him all the land: Gilead as far as Dan,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה מֵעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב אֶל־הַר נְבוֹ רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יְרֵחוֹ וַיַּרְאֵהוּ יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ אֶת־הַגִּלְעָד עַד־דָּן׃

verses.english: all Naphtali, the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah as far as the western sea,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כָּל־נַפְתָּלִי וְאֶת־אֶרֶץ אֶפְרַיִם וּמְנַשֶּׁה וְאֵת כָּל־אֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה עַד הַיָּם הָאַחֲרוֹן׃

verses.english: the Negeb, and the plain—the valley of Jericho, the city of palms—as far as Zoar.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַנֶּגֶב וְאֶת־הַכִּכָּר בִּקְעַת יְרֵחוֹ עִיר הַתְּמָרִים עַד־צֹעַר׃

verses.english: YHWH said to him, “This is the land that I swore to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have let you see it with your eyes, but you shall not cross over there.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָיו זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר לְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה הֶרְאִיתִיךָ בְעֵינֶיךָ וְשָׁמָּה לֹא תַעֲבֹר׃

verses.english: Moses, the servant of YHWH, died there in the land of Moab, by the mouth of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת שָׁם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהוָה בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב עַל־פִּי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor; no one knows his burial place to this day.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּר אֹתוֹ בַגַּיְ בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר וְלֹא־יָדַע אִישׁ אֶת־קְבֻרָתוֹ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died. His eye had not grown dim, and his vigor had not departed.
verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה בֶּן־מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה בְּמֹתוֹ לֹא־כָהֲתָה עֵינוֹ וְלֹא־נָס לֵחֹה׃

verses.english: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days. Then the days of weeping in mourning for Moses ended.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְכּוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם וַיִּתְּמוּ יְמֵי בְכִי אֵבֶל מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: Joshua son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands upon him. The children of Israel listened to him and did as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן מָלֵא רוּחַ חָכְמָה כִּי־סָמַךְ מֹשֶׁה אֶת־יָדָיו עָלָיו וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: No prophet has since arisen in Israel like Moses, whom YHWH knew face to face,
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־קָם נָבִיא עוֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר יְדָעוֹ יְהוָה פָּנִים אֶל־פָּנִים׃

verses.english: in all the signs and wonders that YHWH sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, all his servants and all his land,
verses.hebrew: לְכָל־הָאֹתוֹת וְהַמּוֹפְתִים אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לְפַרְעֹה וּלְכָל־עֲבָדָיו וּלְכָל־אַרְצוֹ׃

verses.english: and in all the mighty hand and all the great terror that Moses displayed before the eyes of all Israel.
verses.hebrew: וּלְכֹל הַיָּד הַחֲזָקָה וּלְכֹל הַמּוֹרָא הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מֹשֶׁה לְעֵינֵי כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
